Method of Attack: Distributes a fake Windows Security Scanner via spam email pretending to be from Microsoft
When executed, shows fake progress bar and ransom screen demanding $500 USD in bitcoins
Targets specific file extensions under C:\Users folder
Corrupts files by reading them as text using File.ReadAllLines, nulling first line, and rewriting causing binary corruption
Deletes original files and appends .Lost_Files_Encrypt extension to corrupted files
Likely functions as a wiper rather than true ransomware
Impacted Systems: Windows systems with user files under C:\Users
Attack Vector: Spam email with malicious attachment WSS.zip containing Windows Security Scanner.exe
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious file: Windows Security Scanner.exe inside WSS.zip
